q1.question: What do Biotherapies consist of?
q1.item1: We begin with a prior diagnosis to establish which Biotherapy best suits your needs.
q1.item2: From the moment the treatment begins, your senses will awaken.
q1.item3: We use quartz and haematite to guide and channel the body's energies correctly.
q1.item4: We apply pressure points and massage.
q1.item5: We use only organic products by Secretos del Agua.
q1.item6: We include our Integrative Remedies, according to the diagnosis carried out.
q1.item7: We accompany you with ongoing advice: every Biotherapy, both facial and body, includes an at-home maintenance treatment.

q2.question: Why should you try the Biotherapies?
q2.answer: We are often unaware of just how much we need to care for our body — to devote a few minutes simply to disconnecting and letting the organism find its balance again. From blood circulation to skin exfoliation and even hydration. Biotherapies go further still: the use of quartz, haematite and brushes turns the experience into a moment of complete relaxation and total disconnection.

q3.question: What is the difference between the Biotherapies and Secretos del Agua at-home treatments?
q3.p1: Whenever desired, a diagnosis is carried out to offer you the best treatment according to your skin's needs. In addition, the Biotherapies use specific professional-only products to achieve a deeper cleanse and maximum hydration. They also incorporate specialist equipment, massage and contact points that aid circulation and improve the penetration of the products applied.
q3.p2: The Biotherapies are complemented by our Integrative Remedies, formulas specially indicated for different organs of the body. The application of the Integrative Remedies goes beyond beautifying the skin: they regulate the organism and help achieve inner balance.
q3.p3: We recommend a facial Biotherapy as an in-depth treatment, followed by the prescribed at-home routine to maintain the results long term. Likewise, for localised body treatments to tone and reduce adiposity, we recommend the Biotherapies as an intensive boost, followed by proper at-home maintenance with the right products.
